name: wechat-search/v2/search
description: Search WeChat with one endpoint: official account articles, accounts, Channels videos, live streams, news and more. Filter by vertical, sort and publish time, with cursor pagination.

raw.title: Raw
raw.description: Optional, default True. True=raw search response; False=simplified parsing.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Optional, default `default`. Sort (result page "sort" dropdown, common to all verticals) — `default`/0 (relevance) / `latest`/1 (newest) / `hot`/2 (most liked); string key or integer, invalid values rejected (400).

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Optional. Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; for the next page pass back the `cursor` returned in the previous response (repeat the same `sort` / `publish_time`), and use `continue_flag` to check whether there are more pages.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Optional, default 0 (>=0). Pass `0` for the first page; **use `cursor` to paginate — offset alone does not work** (it returns the first page every time).

publish_time.title: Publish Time
publish_time.description: Optional, default `all`. Publish time (result page "time" dropdown, common) — `all`/0 / `day`/1 / `week`/2 / `half_year`/3; string key or integer, invalid values rejected (400).

business_type.title: Business Type
business_type.description: Optional, default `all`. Vertical string key, only the following are supported — `all` / `account` / `article` / `video` / `live_stream` / `moments` / `news` / `book` / `listen` / `image` / `encyclopedia` / `weixin_index`; any other value is rejected (422).

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

input.keyword: 南开大学 法学院 2026 博士 拟录取名单

readme:
# WeChat Search API

Run a WeChat universal search for a keyword. Choose the vertical with `business_type` (articles, accounts, videos, live streams, news, and more) and get titles, sources, timestamps and links.

## Use cases

- Find WeChat official account articles about a topic or brand.
- Discover official accounts and Channels creators in a niche.
- Monitor new WeChat coverage with `sort=latest` and `publish_time`.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/wechat-search/v2/search" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"keyword": "OpenAI", "business_type": "article", "raw": false}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keyword` | string | Yes | Search keyword (1-100 chars) |
| `raw` | boolean | No | Optional, default True. |
| `sort` | string | No | Optional, default `default`. |
| `cursor` | string | No | Optional. |
| `offset` | integer | No | Optional, default 0 (>=0). |
| `publish_time` | string | No | Optional, default `all`. |
| `business_type` | string | No | Optional, default `all`. |

## Example response

Real response for the request above, trimmed to the main fields. User names and long IDs are masked.

```json
{
  "keyword": "OpenAI",
  "business_type": 2,
  "count": 38,
  "total": 315,
  "continue_flag": 1,
  "cursor": "<next page cursor>",
  "items": [
    {
      "title": "OpenAI「疯狂28天」首日，这都发了些啥啊…",
      "source": {
        "dateTime": "4小时前",
        "title": "量子位"
      },
      "timestamp": 1791260267,
      "doc_url": "http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIzNjc1NzUzMw==&mid=2247931194&idx=1…"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Notes

- Paginate with `cursor`: pass back the `cursor` from the previous response with the same keyword and filters.
- Set `raw` to `false` for a simplified response.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.
